verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop client that IT teams roll out, so mass deployment applies. The evidence pack never documents an MSI package, MDM profile, silent-install switches, or preset configuration files. The only related claim is that the Teams API can 'automate Parsec deployment', which is an API building block rather than a documented packaged or silent client install, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
